_doc: GENCODE 19 (ftp.ebi.ac.uk/pub/databases/gencode/Gencode_human/release_19), the last release on GRCh37: the GRCh37.p13 genome. Every p13 sequence, IUPAC codes as N, chrY unmasked. The alt scaffolds and patches are in their parents' orientation (orient: reverse-complemented if placed on the minus strand), unpadded: Ensembl's toplevel sequences with the padding taken off. Chromosomes by UCSC name (rCRS as chrM), every other sequence by GenBank accession.
